Sprint 1: Auth refactor, 6 points testing, email notifications
Sprint 2: Dashboard redesign, remaining test debt, PDF export begins

This code—this plan—is primitive. Amusing, but primitive.

*pauses*

Yet it may survive. Which is more than I can say for most of what your cycle produces.

The sprint begins Monday. Further negotiation is... inadvisable.
